local_coordinate_frame.note: Semantic datums are defined in the Defender local frame and targets are emitted as camera-space 3D coordinates.

origin_definition: Midpoint of the canonical measured body-shell bounding box.

keypoints.name: blocked_unresolved_semantic_datum_08
keypoints.blocker: Exact fixed amodal semantic datum 8 has not been specified. Training must fail until this datum is resolved.

keypoints.name: blocked_unresolved_semantic_datum_09
keypoints.blocker: Exact fixed amodal semantic datum 9 has not been specified. Training must fail until this datum is resolved.

measurement_notes: The first eight datums are body-shell bounding-box corners.
Datums 8 and 9 are deliberately blocked until exact semantic choices are available.
Amodal 3D targets are supervised regardless of per-keypoint visibility.
visibility_test_method: A keypoint is visible when the semantic datum is directly visible to the camera under the dataset generator occlusion and self-occlusion test; visibility is an auxiliary target and must not mask amodal 3D supervision.
